dedupe_keys.name: anonymized emergency department visit and transfer dataset

description: Sung-Ha Kim at CHA University publishes anonymised emergency-department visit and transfer data from Bundang CHA Medical Center. The accompanying study examines the 2024 Korean medical-workforce disruption and compares paediatric and adult transfers before and after it. Zenodo lists an anonymised workbook, an aggregate transfer workbook and a README. The December 2025 deposit is open under CC BY 4.0 and free to obtain. The description identifies interrupted time-series, logistic-regression and sensitivity analyses as intended uses. A modeller could also use the transfer observations when checking assumptions about hospital-service disruption. Exact observation dates, row counts and temporal aggregation intervals remain unknown from the inspected page. The authors state that identifiers have been removed; the underlying files were not inspected. Results from this single institution need care when transferred elsewhere. No direct catalogue relationship is documented.
